items.title: EU AI Act guidance sharpens due-diligence duties for law firms
items.excerpt: Firms deploying generative tools face new documentation duties, client-disclosure questions, and a tighter definition of high-risk use in legal services.

items.title: Delaware court clarifies board oversight in merger disputes
items.excerpt: The opinion draws a sharper line between good-faith oversight and process failures, giving deal counsel a clearer checklist for board minutes and advisor records.

items.title: El reglamento europeo de IA obliga a revisar la diligencia en los despachos
items.excerpt: Los despachos que usan herramientas generativas deberán documentar riesgos, informar al cliente y revisar contratos con proveedores tecnológicos.

items.title: Basel endgame delays push banks to revisit capital planning
items.excerpt: Supervisors signaled a longer transition, but mid-size lenders still need to model higher risk weights and tighter liquidity buffers ahead of the next stress cycle.

items.title: Real-time payments adoption accelerates across mid-size banks
items.excerpt: Fraud controls and reconciliation remain the gating items as instant settlement moves from pilot programs into everyday commercial accounts.

items.title: La banca española acelera sus planes de capital ante el retraso de Basilea
items.excerpt: Las entidades revisan sus modelos de riesgo y prevén recompras condicionadas mientras la autoridad supervisora ajusta el calendario de implantación.

items.title: Telehealth prescribing rules tighten for controlled substances
items.excerpt: Clinicians face new documentation and in-person referral requirements, with particular attention to continuity of care for patients in rural areas.

items.title: Large trial links sleep regularity to depression outcomes
items.excerpt: Consistency in sleep timing predicted symptom improvement more strongly than total sleep duration, suggesting a practical target for behavioral activation.

items.title: La telepsiquiatría gana terreno pero exige controles más estrictos
items.excerpt: Los profesionales piden protocolos claros para recetas controladas, derivaciones presenciales y seguimiento de pacientes con riesgo elevado.

items.title: Education Department opens new rules on accreditation and oversight
items.excerpt: The proposed framework would change how agencies are recognized and how institutions report student outcomes, with a comment window opening this month.

items.title: Colleges rethink admissions essays as AI use spreads
items.excerpt: Admissions offices are testing shorter prompts and in-person writing samples while trying to preserve access for applicants without private coaching.

items.title: Las universidades revisan sus procesos de admisión ante el avance de la IA
items.excerpt: Varias instituciones combinan ensayos más breves con entrevistas y muestras de escritura presenciales para verificar el trabajo del solicitante.

items.title: Ocean carriers add surcharges as Red Sea rerouting persists
items.excerpt: Longer routings are absorbing capacity and pushing spot rates higher on Asia-Europe lanes, with shippers locking in forward contracts earlier than usual.

items.title: Customs brokers brace for tariff classification changes
items.excerpt: New guidance on component origin and de minimis treatment is forcing importers to re-audit product data before the next compliance deadline.

items.title: Las navieras amplían recargos mientras se mantienen las rutas alternas
items.excerpt: La capacidad absorbida por los desvíos eleva las tarifas al contado y obliga a los cargadores a negociar contratos con mayor antelación.
